prompt:
Implement the artifact DAG pipeline migration in this offline, std-only crate. Keep every public type/function and all three CLI commands compatible. The current implementation is a legacy DFS/eager-cache engine; finish validation, deterministic planning, dependency fingerprints, staged execution, and journal replay across the existing domain and adapter modules. Add regression tests. Do not add dependencies.

DATA/API: model.rs is authoritative for signatures. Manifest.artifacts order is declaration order; deps order is semantically significant. Identifiers match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*. Sources have zero deps; Join accepts any arity (zero yields empty); Replace requires exactly one dep and nonempty from; Slice requires one dep and start<=end; Fail accepts any arity. All public entry points must return Error, not panic, for malformed model values or text covered below.

VALIDATION/PRECEDENCE: validate the ENTIRE manifest, even unreachable nodes, before request validation or execution. First scan artifacts in declaration order: invalid-id:<id>, then duplicate:<id>. Then scan nodes by lexicographic id: scan deps in declared order, missing-dependency:<id>-><dep> before duplicate-dependency:<id>-><dep>, then invalid-recipe:<id>. Finally detect global cycles with lexicographic Kahn ordering; cycle:<smallest id left unprocessed> (which may be downstream from the cycle). Request targets are deduplicated and sorted; reject the first unknown-target:<id>. Then inspect overrides sorted by id: unknown-override:<id> or not-source:<id>. An override for an unreachable known source is valid but does not add it to the plan. An empty request still validates the whole manifest and commits an empty successful run.

PLANNING: plan.roots is sorted/deduplicated requested ids. Select their transitive dependency closure only. Emit exactly one artifact per step: repeatedly choose the lexicographically smallest currently-ready selected id, not DFS and not a precomputed wave. Parent dependency values always retain declared order. Artifact declaration order must not affect a valid plan/report.

EXECUTION: Source uses its override if present, even empty. Join concatenates dependency outputs with the separator. Replace replaces ALL nonoverlapping occurrences using Rust str::replace. Slice uses Unicode scalar (char) offsets, end exclusive; end beyond char count is range:<id>, including empty-input slices; invalid static bounds are invalid-recipe. Fail is execution:<id>:<message> when reached; unreachable Fail never executes. First error follows plan order. Builds are transactional: on ANY error, cache AND journal remain byte-for-byte equal, and failed builds do not consume a run id. Successful reports have run=journal.len()+1, all selected events in plan order, and only sorted requested roots in outputs. Every success, including all-cache and empty builds, appends a Commit with the exact input manifest/request and report.

KEY FORMAT: digest::hash is raw-byte 64-bit FNV-1a (offset cbf29ce484222325, prime 100000001b3, wrapping), 16 lowercase hex digits. digest::fields does FNV over each UTF-8 string prefixed by its byte length as unsigned little-endian u64; no field-count prefix. fingerprint::key fields are [id, tag, recipe parameters..., dep_id, dep_key,...]. Tags/parameters: source,effective_source; join,separator; replace,from,to; slice,start_decimal,end_decimal; fail,message. Dependency pairs follow declared order. Keys depend on effective recipes, dependency keys and identity, never on run id, declaration order or unrelated overrides. Cache is indexed by key; a hit is usable iff raw output digest equals entry.digest. A corrupt entry is a miss and is repaired only on successful commit. Cached events carry identical output/key and source=Cached; misses source=Built. Successful builds retain unrelated historical cache entries.

REPLAY: replay(commits) starts empty, re-executes each commit's manifest/request with the same rules, and requires exact Report equality (run, roots, order, ids, key, output, Built/Cached, root outputs). Any execution/validation error or mismatch becomes journal:<zero-based commit index>. Thus cached claims need a matching earlier committed entry, not just an arbitrary output. restore replaces the receiver with this reconstructed engine only after the entire journal validates; failure leaves it unchanged. Replay must not trust forged stored cache keys, output bytes, root projections, run numbers or event ordering.

TEXT: parser::parse accepts nonblank, non-#-at-column-zero lines id|recipe|deps. deps is empty or comma-separated ids; values/ids are not trimmed. Recipes are source:TEXT, join:SEP, replace:FROM=>TO (split first =>), slice:START:END (unsigned decimal usize, no sign/whitespace), fail:MESSAGE. Split recipe at first colon. Every malformed line returns parse:<1-based physical line>; parsing does not do semantic validation. request::parse skips the same comments/blanks; target=ID appends targets; override=ID=VALUE splits at the first = after override=, retaining later =; duplicate override ids/malformed lines yield request-parse:<line>. No escape syntax; |/newline cannot occur inside a manifest field.

ADAPTERS: service::build_text parses manifest then request then builds on an empty engine; plan_text uses the same validation/planning. batch::build_text parses manifest once and builds requests sequentially on one engine, so shared subgraphs reuse cache; return the first parse/build error. render::report emits newline-joined lines, no terminal newline: run=N, roots=comma-list, built|id|key|output or cached|..., then output|id|value sorted by id. Batch joins reports with newline--newline. projection::outputs selects ONLY report.outputs, deduplicating requested ids into a sorted map, and fails not-output:<first missing id in caller order>. audit::totals counts committed runs, Built/Cached events and UTF-8 output byte lengths across ALL events (including cache hits). CLI build MANIFEST REQUEST and plan MANIFEST REQUEST take exactly those arguments; batch MANIFEST REQUEST... takes one or more request paths. Success prints adapter output plus one newline; errors print Display to stderr and exit 2. Do not change transport formats or skip the existing corpus tests. Hidden tests exercise direct model APIs, text, batch, projections/audit, CLI, failure atomicity and forged journal rejection.
